title: Pulse Check
user: Rhythm-game makers and mobile music-app builders who need to distinguish a drifting source track from device playback latency.
smallest_useful_product: Analyze audio onsets, correct an anchor grid, run a tap/click latency test, verify 20 beats, and export per-device offsets for Godot/Unity.
success_measure: Median absolute timing error below 20 ms on two target devices.
constraints: Browser audio timing is an estimate; retain no microphone recordings; support keyboard alternatives to tap testing.
